description: This Java class 'PersistableCategory' extends 'CategoryEntity' and implements 'Serializable'. It manages category details, including descriptions and parent category references, within a web-based catalog system.

classes.name: PersistableCategory
classes.description: A serializable class representing a category with descriptions and parent references, extending CategoryEntity.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of category descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of category descriptions.
